stock.description: i-Control Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, specializing in comprehensive video conferencing and multimedia audiovisual (VCMA) solutions for clients in Hong Kong, mainland China, and Singapore. The firm's business is structured into two main divisions: the deployment and ongoing maintenance of VCMA solutions, and the provision of managed, cloud-based IT and operational technology services. These cloud offerings include advanced Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) operations and robust security services. Its VCMA solutions encompass a full spectrum of services, from initial project consultation and design through to project management, installation, maintenance, corporate advisory, and complete audio-visual system integration. The company also holds property assets. i-Control serves a diverse array of clients, including governmental bodies, financial organizations, multinational enterprises, publicly listed companies, and educational institutions. Established in 1987, the company's headquarters are located in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.
